sets.title: 图书馆志愿者
sets.scene: 你将扮演校园小记者，采访学校图书馆的志愿者负责人 Mr. Li。采访前会观看一段关于图书馆志愿者活动的对话视频（只播放一次），请边听边记下人物、时间、地点、数字等信息。

dialogue.t: Mr. Li, I heard that the school library now has many student volunteers.
Yes. We started the volunteer program last September. Every Saturday morning, they come to the library.
What do the volunteers usually do there?
They tidy the bookshelves, help students find books, and tell stories to the younger students.
That sounds great. Do you often hold reading activities?
Yes, we do. We hold a reading activity once a month. Last time we had a book-sharing meeting, and about forty students joined it.
How can other students join the volunteer team?
They can sign up at the library office before this Friday.

q3.cn: 你什么时候开始当志愿者的？
q3.en: When did the volunteer program start?

q3.cn: 志愿者平时在图书馆做哪些工作？
q3.en: What do the volunteers usually do in the library?

q3.cn: 你们多久举办一次读书活动？
q3.en: How often do you hold reading activities?

a5.q: When did the volunteer program start?
a5.a: It started last September.

a5.q: How often do the volunteers work?
a5.a: They work every Saturday morning.

a5.q: What do the volunteers do in the library?
a5.a: They tidy the bookshelves, help students find books and tell stories to younger students.

a5.q: How many students joined the last book-sharing meeting?
a5.a: About forty.

a5.q: How can other students join the volunteer team?
a5.a: They can sign up at the library office before this Friday.
a5.points: 方式/时间：本周五前到图书馆办公室报名

q3: Q1 易错：缺助动词（When you start?）或用错人称（the volunteer program 是单数，用 did）；因 last September 用过去时。
Q2 易错：主语 volunteers 复数用 do，误用 does。
Q3 易错：How often 问频率（答案含 once a month），别误用 How long 问时长。
a5: A1 时间信息必须完整（last September），不能只答 Yes。
A2 频率答 Every Saturday morning，漏 morning 算信息不完整。
A3 三项工作缺一项扣信息分，用 and 连接保持流畅。
A4 数字 forty 是关键信息，发音要清楚。
A5 方式（sign up at the library office）+ 时限（before this Friday）都要答到。

sets.trap: 时间/频率/数量信息捕捉 + 动词时态

sets.title: 学校科技节
sets.scene: 你将扮演学校广播站记者，采访学生会主席 Wang Lin，了解即将举办的科技节。先观看一段关于科技节的对话视频（只播放一次），留意时间、地点、内容、人数等信息。

dialogue.t: Hi, Wang Lin. I heard the school will hold a science and technology festival. When will it start?
It will start on March 20th and last for three days.
Where will the festival be held?
In the school hall. We have robot shows, model-making competitions and science lectures there.
Who will give the science lectures?
Professor Chen from Sun Yat-sen University will give two lectures. He is an expert on AI.
How many students can take part in the model-making competition?
At most forty students, and they need to sign up in groups of four before March 5th.
Why do you hold this festival?
Because we want to help students learn science in a fun way.

q3.cn: 科技节什么时候开始？
q3.en: When will the science and technology festival start?

q3.cn: 科技节在哪里举行？
q3.en: Where will the festival be held?

q3.cn: 谁来做科学讲座？
q3.en: Who will give the science lectures?

a5.q: When will the science and technology festival start?
a5.a: It will start on March 20th.

a5.q: How long will the festival last?
a5.a: It will last for three days.

a5.q: Where will the festival be held?
a5.a: In the school hall.

a5.q: Who will give the science lectures?
a5.a: Professor Chen from Sun Yat-sen University.

a5.q: How many students can take part in the model-making competition?
a5.a: At most forty, and they need to sign up in groups of four.
a5.points: 数量+规则：最多 40 人、4 人一组

q3: Q1 将来事件用 will start（on March 20th），别用一般现在时 starts。
Q2 地点问句 Where will the festival be held?，别漏被动语态或宾语（Where will hold the festival?）。
Q3 who 作主语后直接跟动词（who will give），不能再加助动词（Who does will give）。
a5: A1 日期 on March 20th 要完整。
A2 时长 three days 来自 last for three days，别漏 for。
A3 地点 In the school hall，只答 school 信息不全。
A4 人物+单位（Professor Chen + Sun Yat-sen University）要完整。
A5 数量 at most forty + 规则 in groups of four 都要答。

sets.trap: 将来时 will + 被动语态 be held + who 主语句型

sets.title: 环保讲座
sets.scene: 你是一名校园记者，讲座结束后采访环保专家 Dr. Smith。先观看一段关于环保讲座的对话视频（只播放一次），留意讲座主题、时间、数据、做法等信息。

dialogue.t: Dr. Smith, thank you for the wonderful lecture. What is the lecture mainly about?
It is about how to reduce plastic waste in our daily life.
How much plastic waste do students in our city produce every year?
About five thousand tons every year. That is a big problem.
What can students do to help?
They can use water bottles instead of plastic ones, bring their own shopping bags, and separate waste at home.
Has the city set a goal for waste reduction?
Yes. The city plans to cut plastic waste by half in five years, by 2030.
Why did you become an environmental scientist?
Because I want to protect the earth for the next generation.

q3.cn: 讲座主要讲什么？
q3.en: What is the lecture mainly about?

q3.cn: 学生可以做些什么来帮助减少塑料垃圾？
q3.en: What can students do to help reduce plastic waste?

q3.cn: 你为什么要成为一名环保科学家？
q3.en: Why did you become an environmental scientist?

a5.q: What is the lecture mainly about?
a5.a: It is about how to reduce plastic waste in our daily life.

a5.q: How much plastic waste do students in the city produce every year?
a5.a: About five thousand tons.

a5.q: What can students do to help?
a5.a: They can use water bottles instead of plastic ones, bring their own shopping bags, and separate waste at home.

a5.q: What is the city's goal for waste reduction?
a5.a: To cut plastic waste by half in five years, by 2030.

a5.q: Why did Dr. Smith become an environmental scientist?
a5.a: Because he wants to protect the earth for the next generation.
a5.points: 原因：为下一代保护地球

q3: Q1 主语 the lecture 单数用 is；别用陈述语序（What the lecture is about?）。
Q2 情态动词 can 后接动词原形（do/to help），别多加 to（What can students to do?）。
Q3 did 后接原形 become，别写成 did became。
a5: A1 主题要完整（in our daily life 别漏）。
A2 数字 five thousand tons 是关键，别只说 a lot of。
A3 三个做法缺一项扣分，用 and 连接。
A4 目标 = cut by half + in five years + by 2030，三要素都要有。
A5 原因句 Because + 现在时 wants（他现在的愿望），别误用过去时。

sets.trap: 情态动词 can + 过去时 did 疑问 + 数字信息

sets.scene: 你将扮演校园记者，采访学生会文化部部长 Li Hua，了解即将举办的校园传统文化节。先观看一段对话视频（只播放一次），留意活动时间、地点、内容、人数等信息。

dialogue.t: Hi, Li Hua. I heard the school will hold a Chinese Culture Festival. When will it be held?
It will be held from May 20th to 22nd, in the school hall and on the playground.
What activities will there be at the festival?
There will be paper-cutting, calligraphy and a hanfu show. Students can also try traditional food.
That sounds interesting. How many students took part in the festival last year?
More than three hundred students joined it last year.
How can students take part in the activities?
They can register online before Friday, and the registration is free.
Why do you hold such a festival?
Because we want to help students learn about and love traditional Chinese culture.

a5.a: In the school hall and on the playground.

sets.title: 健康生活讲座
sets.scene: 你将扮演校园记者，采访校医 Dr. Chen，了解即将举办的学生健康讲座。先观看一段对话视频（只播放一次），留意讲座主题、时间、建议等信息。

dialogue.t: Dr. Chen, thank you for your time. What is the lecture mainly about?
It is about healthy eating and living habits for students.
What should students do to keep healthy?
They should eat breakfast every morning, drink enough water, and sleep for about eight hours a night.
Why is having breakfast so important?
Because it gives students energy for the morning classes. Many students skip breakfast, and that is a big problem.
What about exercise? How much exercise do students need?
About an hour of exercise every day, like running, swimming or playing ball games.
When will the lecture be held?
At 4 p.m. this Wednesday in the school hall.

q3.cn: 讲座主要讲什么？
q3.en: What is the lecture mainly about?

q3.cn: 学生应该怎样保持健康？
q3.en: What should students do to keep healthy?

q3.cn: 为什么吃早餐很重要？
q3.en: Why is having breakfast important?

a5.q: What is the lecture mainly about?
a5.a: Healthy eating and living habits for students.
a5.points: 主题：健康饮食与生活习惯

a5.q: How many hours of sleep do students need?
a5.a: About eight hours a night.

sets.title: 城市绿色出行
sets.scene: 你是一名校园小记者，采访市交通部门工作人员 Mr. Wang，了解城市绿色出行的情况。先观看一段对话视频（只播放一次），留意主题、数据、新变化等信息。

dialogue.t: Mr. Wang, what is green travel exactly?
It means travelling by public transport, walking or riding bikes instead of driving cars.
I heard a new metro line opened recently. Is that right?
Yes. Line 5 opened last month, and it connects the city centre with the university town.
What about shared bikes? How many are there in the city?
About ten thousand shared bikes are available now, and they are great for short trips.
Does green travel really help reduce traffic?
Yes. The city expects car use to drop by about twenty percent in the next two years.
How can students travel in a green way?
They can walk or ride bikes to school, or take the metro and the bus.

q3.cn: 什么是绿色出行？
q3.en: What is green travel?

q3.cn: 最近交通方面有什么新变化？
q3.en: What changes have happened to transport recently?

q3.cn: 学生怎样做到绿色出行？
q3.en: How can students travel in a green way?

a5.q: What is green travel?
a5.a: It means travelling by public transport, walking or riding bikes instead of driving cars.
a5.points: 定义：公共交通/步行/骑行

a5.q: When did Line 5 open?
a5.a: It opened last month.

a5.q: How many shared bikes are there in the city?
a5.a: About ten thousand.

a5.q: What are shared bikes great for?
a5.a: Short trips.

a5.q: How much is car use expected to drop?
a5.a: By about twenty percent in the next two years.

q3: Q1 定义类问句 What is green travel? 用一般现在时 is。
Q2 现在完成时 What changes have happened...? 注意 have+过去分词。
Q3 方式问法 How can students...? 答案含 walk/ride/take metro。
a5: A1 定义要完整（by public transport, walking or riding bikes）。
A2 时间 last month 关键。
A3 数字 ten thousand 关键。
A4 用途 short trips。
A5 降幅 twenty percent + 时间 next two years 都要答。

sets.trap: 现在完成时 have happened + 数字/定义类信息完整性

sets.title: 学习方法与备考
sets.scene: 你将扮演校园记者，采访高三优秀学生代表 Li Ming，请他分享学习与备考经验。先观看一段对话视频（只播放一次），留意方法、时间安排、心态建议等信息。

dialogue.t: Li Ming, congratulations on your great results. What methods do you usually use to learn English?
Thank you. I review my notes every evening, practise with test papers, and speak English with my classmates.
How do you arrange your revision time before exams?
I make a 30-minute plan for each subject every evening and stick to it. I never study late into the night.
Why do you think sleep is important before exams?
Because enough sleep helps students stay focused in class and remember things better.
What should students do if they feel nervous before exams?
They should take deep breaths, tell themselves they are ready, and do a little exercise to relax.
Who can students turn to if they have problems with their studies?
They can ask their teachers for help, or discuss with classmates in study groups.

q3.en: What should students do if they feel nervous before exams?

sets.title: 人工智能与学习
sets.scene: 你将扮演校园记者，采访大学教授 Dr. Wang，了解人工智能如何帮助学生学习。先观看一段对话视频（只播放一次），留意讲座主题、时间、使用建议等信息。

dialogue.t: Dr. Wang, thank you for the lecture. What is the lecture mainly about?
It is about how artificial intelligence, or AI, can help students learn.
What can AI tools do for students?
They can translate words, check pronunciation, and give personalised exercises according to each student's level.
What is the biggest advantage of AI in learning?
It can make a personalised learning plan for every student, so everyone learns at their own speed.
What should students pay attention to when using AI tools?
They should use AI wisely and not depend on it too much. Learning still needs hard work.
When and where will the lecture be held?
At 7 p.m. next Tuesday in the lecture hall. Everyone is welcome.

sets.trap: can/should 情态动词 + when+动名词 + 时间地点信息完整

dialogue.t: Hi, Amy. When will the music festival be held?
It will be held on Saturday evening, at the end of this month, in the school hall.
What performances will there be?
There will be the school band, a chorus, and some solo performances by talented students.
I heard there is a special part this year. What is it?
Yes. We will hold a charity performance to raise money for students in mountain schools.
How many people came to the festival last year?
About five hundred people came last year, and we expect even more this year.
How can students join the performances?
They can sign up at the music club before next Monday and have an audition.

sets.title: 心理健康与减压
sets.scene: 你将扮演校园记者，采访心理老师 Ms. Liu，了解学生心理健康与减压方法。先观看一段对话视频（只播放一次），留意常见问题、建议、咨询室开放时间等信息。

dialogue.t: Ms. Liu, what mental problems do students often have?
Many students feel anxious before exams, and some feel stressed about too much homework.
What can students do to reduce stress?
They can do some exercise, talk to friends or parents, and listen to music to relax.
When is the school counseling room open?
It is open on Monday, Wednesday and Friday afternoons, from 3 to 5 p.m.
How can students make an appointment?
They can book online through the school website, or just come and talk to us.
Will the school hold any activities about mental health?
Yes. We will hold a stress-relief lecture next Wednesday evening in the library hall.
